name: reactor-field-5-walk-left
description: #77 attempt 1 (diagnostic): from reactor-entrance, hold left for 60 frames, then 10 frames with no input. Reports the sign of the change (-1/0/1) of each position candidate (g_FieldEntity[0..1] PosX/Y/Z, signed); no coordinate leaves. The check "changed" fails for candidates that did not move: this is a diagnostic.
